name: Brett Matsumoto
current_role: Commissioner of the Bureau of Labor Statistics (since August 2026)
summary: Brett Matsumoto, a career Bureau of Labor Statistics economist, was confirmed 51–47 in an August 2026 block vote to lead the agency, a year after Trump fired its previous commissioner over weak jobs numbers and after the White House withdrew E.J. Antoni’s nomination. He has said he would be the bureau’s only political appointee.
